raw: Theresis falls in the ocean of information. The massive quantity buffets him, assimilating his cognition.
content: Theresis falls in the ocean of information. The massive quantity buffets him, assimilating his cognition.

raw: He can feel his mind grow slow, but he still tries to follow the guidance left behind by Theresa—
content: He can feel his mind grow slow, but he still tries to follow the guidance left behind by Theresa—

raw: Guided by his sword, the information flow reconstructed by Theresa clashes with the preexisting one.
content: Guided by his sword, the information flow reconstructed by Theresa clashes with the preexisting one.

raw: The massive collision lasts only an instant.
content: The massive collision lasts only an instant.

raw: The surface begins to surge. Then, the sea splits open, as if sliced by a sharp blade.
content: The surface begins to surge. Then, the sea splits open, as if sliced by a sharp blade.

raw: A dark abyss appears in the Assimilated Universe. The sea of data stirs and roils.
content: A dark abyss appears in the Assimilated Universe. The sea of data stirs and roils.

raw: Waves crashing against waves, drowning out one another.
content: Waves crashing against waves, drowning out one another.

raw: Even as his mind grows numb, Theresis can sense the will gazing upon him weaken rapidly.
content: Even as his mind grows numb, Theresis can sense the will gazing upon him weaken rapidly.

speaker: Theresis
content: Your plan worked, Theresa.

raw: [name="Theresis"]Sever their control over Amnannam and seize it—
speaker: Theresis
content: Sever their control over Amnannam and seize it—

raw: But suddenly, all the violent scenes come to a screeching halt.
content: But suddenly, all the violent scenes come to a screeching halt.

raw: She opens her eyes and sees the small, frail creature.
content: She opens her eyes and sees the small, frail creature.
(Unknown language) Connection... unstable.
(Unknown language) —It's you?

raw: [name="Calm Voice"](Unknown language) Your actions surprise me.
speaker: Calm Voice
content: (Unknown language) Your actions surprise me.

speaker: Calm Voice
content: (Unknown language) ...'Theresa' and 'Theresis'.

raw: Theresis does not comprehend the space before him. Perhaps it is simply another illusion of a dying mind—
content: Theresis does not comprehend the space before him. Perhaps it is simply another illusion of a dying mind—

raw: Until he hears a familiar language that he can understand.
content: Until he hears a familiar language that he can understand.

raw: [name="Calm Voice"]Ah, but perhaps this was the result that one wanted to see?
speaker: Calm Voice
content: Ah, but perhaps this was the result that one wanted to see?

raw: [name="Calm Voice"]Your intentions are as easy to decipher as your language.
speaker: Calm Voice
content: Your intentions are as easy to decipher as your language.

raw: [name="Calm Voice"]The evolution of Terra had brought many surprises... a shame.
speaker: Calm Voice
content: The evolution of Terra had brought many surprises... a shame.

speaker: Theresis
content: You think we failed.

raw: [name="Theresis"]Then why do you hide and refuse to show yourself?
speaker: Theresis
content: Then why do you hide and refuse to show yourself?

raw: He meditatively swings his sword, guiding the chaotic information through the pure-white space...
content: He meditatively swings his sword, guiding the chaotic information through the pure-white space...

speaker: Theresis
content: Falsehoods.

raw: [name="Priestess"]You've implemented a backdoor in my project and restricted my access.
speaker: Priestess
content: You've implemented a backdoor in my project and restricted my access.

raw: [name="Priestess"]The data tells me I'm losing this piece of Originium. My attempts at maintenance have been in vain.
speaker: Priestess
content: The data tells me I'm losing this piece of Originium. My attempts at maintenance have been in vain.

raw: [name="Priestess"]Impressive. Your rash actions have borne fruit.
speaker: Priestess
content: Impressive. Your rash actions have borne fruit.

raw: There is nothing physically imposing to the voice whispering about failure before Theresis.
content: There is nothing physically imposing to the voice whispering about failure before Theresis.

raw: But this simply serves to make him more wary.
content: But this simply serves to make him more wary.

speaker: Theresis
content: Your arrogance reminds me of someone.

raw: [name="Theresis"]Someone who deceived me. There is more than one evil spirit of a bygone age.
speaker: Theresis
content: Someone who deceived me. There is more than one evil spirit of a bygone age.

speaker: Priestess
content: Dr. {@nickname}... I see you've met.

speaker: Priestess
content: Then let me introduce myself.

speaker: Priestess
content: Priestess. Linguist, and colleague to Dr. {@nickname}.

raw: Theresis cannot care less who Priestess is.
content: Theresis cannot care less who Priestess is.

raw: Priestess or evil spirit, it makes no difference to him.
content: Priestess or evil spirit, it makes no difference to him.

raw: He clutches his sword tightly. He will find a way to break through.
content: He clutches his sword tightly. He will find a way to break through.

raw: [name="Priestess"]You are anxious to defy a reality that you cannot perceive, Theresis.
speaker: Priestess
content: You are anxious to defy a reality that you cannot perceive, Theresis.

raw: [name="Priestess"]You were much calmer when you plotted with {@nickname} on the border of Kazdel.
speaker: Priestess
content: You were much calmer when you plotted with {@nickname} on the border of Kazdel.

speaker: Theresis
content: You were watching...

speaker: Priestess
content: Watching? No.

raw: [name="Priestess"]I have long lost the energy and passion to observe the evolution of a newborn civilization.
speaker: Priestess
content: I have long lost the energy and passion to observe the evolution of a newborn civilization.

raw: [name="Priestess"]All I did was look up the data newly added to Originium, and checked some information that interested me.
speaker: Priestess
content: All I did was look up the data newly added to Originium, and checked some information that interested me.

raw: [name="Priestess"]The expansion of Originium is a consensus between me and {@nickname}.
speaker: Priestess
content: The expansion of Originium is a consensus between me and {@nickname}.

raw: [name="Priestess"]The current circumstances of Terra have somewhat differed from our predictions, but it remains on track.
speaker: Priestess
content: The current circumstances of Terra have somewhat differed from our predictions, but it remains on track.

raw: [name="Priestess"]I admit to being surprised by your attempt to retake this Originium, but the duty of it will be fulfilled, no matter how you struggle.
speaker: Priestess
content: I admit to being surprised by your attempt to retake this Originium, but the duty of it will be fulfilled, no matter how you struggle.

raw: [name="Theresis"]You can believe what you want, creator of Originium.
speaker: Theresis
content: You can believe what you want, creator of Originium.

raw: [name="Theresis"]You believe that Originium is immovable, but she opened a path here, and liberated the myriad souls.
speaker: Theresis
content: You believe that Originium is immovable, but she opened a path here, and liberated the myriad souls.

raw: [name="Theresis"]She was not the first to resist, and I will not be the last. Someone will stand before you—
speaker: Theresis
content: She was not the first to resist, and I will not be the last. Someone will stand before you—

raw: [name="Theresis"]Until there is none left to toy with our fate.
speaker: Theresis
content: Until there is none left to toy with our fate.

raw: [name="Priestess"]'Fate'... do you continue to believe that Originium stands opposed to the fate of your civilization?
speaker: Priestess
content: 'Fate'... do you continue to believe that Originium stands opposed to the fate of your civilization?

raw: [name="Priestess"]If you truly understand the history of your people, have you ever questioned why you have evolved in our likeness?
speaker: Priestess
content: If you truly understand the history of your people, have you ever questioned why you have evolved in our likeness?

raw: [name="Priestess"]You do not understand what you are resisting.
speaker: Priestess
content: You do not understand what you are resisting.

raw: Theresis observes his surroundings. He is certain that he is still inside Originium.
content: Theresis observes his surroundings. He is certain that he is still inside Originium.

raw: The nature of what makes up this place is no different from the tower that Theresa weaved—it is information reconstructed.
content: The nature of what makes up this place is no different from the tower that Theresa weaved—it is information reconstructed.

raw: Theresa has left him the key. He is sure he can put an end to this enigma.
content: Theresa has left him the key. He is sure he can put an end to this enigma.

speaker: Priestess
content: You noticed.

raw: [name="Theresis"]You do not have a real physical form. We're still in that ocean.
speaker: Theresis
content: You do not have a real physical form. We're still in that ocean.

raw: [name="Priestess"]In the language of Originium, reality and falsehood are not polar opposites.
speaker: Priestess
content: In the language of Originium, reality and falsehood are not polar opposites.

raw: [name="Priestess"]When I first created this language, I wanted it to decipher the ultimate question that we had been unable to answer, despite all our efforts.
speaker: Priestess
content: When I first created this language, I wanted it to decipher the ultimate question that we had been unable to answer, despite all our efforts.

speaker: Priestess
content: It.

raw: [name="Priestess"]{@nickname} once had hope for the beings on this land... guiding them to evolve and seek hope through Originium, giving them a chance to face It, perhaps even overcome It.
speaker: Priestess
content: {@nickname} once had hope for the beings on this land... guiding them to evolve and seek hope through Originium, giving them a chance to face It, perhaps even overcome It.

speaker: Priestess
content: But they are doomed to despair.

raw: [name="Priestess"]'Teekaz'. You were not part of the plan, but you became the species most affected by Originium. An accident.
speaker: Priestess
content: 'Teekaz'. You were not part of the plan, but you became the species most affected by Originium. An accident.

raw: [name="Priestess"]I must applaud your courage for standing here.
speaker: Priestess
content: I must applaud your courage for standing here.

raw: [name="Theresis"]An accident...? Is this how you summarize our fate?
speaker: Theresis
content: An accident...? Is this how you summarize our fate?

speaker: Theresis
content: You're certainly alike, Priestess.

raw: [name="Theresis"]You call the fates you toy with a gift of hope, millennia of suffering a necessary sacrifice.
speaker: Theresis
content: You call the fates you toy with a gift of hope, millennia of suffering a necessary sacrifice.

speaker: Theresis
content: But {@nickname} was honest, at least.

raw: His sword pierces falsehood, but the space on the other side—
content: His sword pierces falsehood, but the space on the other side—

name: $eb_glow_l

speaker: Theresis
content: Nothing changed?

raw: Theresis closes his eyes and raises his sword.
content: Theresis closes his eyes and raises his sword.

speaker: Priestess
content: Your violence is meaningless.

raw: [name="Theresis"]If you didn't care whether this pathetic race of mine can seize its own fate, you should have eliminated me already.
speaker: Theresis
content: If you didn't care whether this pathetic race of mine can seize its own fate, you should have eliminated me already.

raw: [name="Theresis"]You're still weak after awakening from a long dream, are you not, Presence?
speaker: Theresis
content: You're still weak after awakening from a long dream, are you not, Presence?

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.5, xstrength=40, ystrength=40, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]

content: He lunges without hesitation.

raw: The sword-wave cuts through the figure, disappearing without a sound into the pale white wall in the distance.
content: The sword-wave cuts through the figure, disappearing without a sound into the pale white wall in the distance.

speaker: Priestess
content: I said, this is meaningless.

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.5, xstrength=40, ystrength=40, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]

content: Another strike.

raw: [name="Theresis"]I've always wondered—what exactly is the difference between you, the self-proclaimed creators, and us?
speaker: Theresis
content: I've always wondered—what exactly is the difference between you, the self-proclaimed creators, and us?

name: $eb_glow_l

raw: Theresis holds nothing back. The white wall begins to crack.
content: Theresis holds nothing back. The white wall begins to crack.

raw: [name="Theresis"]You have not brought everything to a standstill.
speaker: Theresis
content: You have not brought everything to a standstill.

raw: [name="Theresis"]You just wanted to buy more time, or simply to mock the struggles of a pathetic race...
speaker: Theresis
content: You just wanted to buy more time, or simply to mock the struggles of a pathetic race...

speaker: Theresis
content: Suit yourself, Priestess.

raw: [CameraShake(duration=4, xstrength=5, ystrength=5, vibrato=90, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
Once again, Theresis senses the surging tide of information, remnants of the broken tower that Theresa weaved.
content: Once again, Theresis senses the surging tide of information, remnants of the broken tower that Theresa weaved.
Theresis swings again.

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.5, xstrength=40, ystrength=40, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
Golden seawater shatters the pale wall, rushing into this seemingly boundless white space.
content: Golden seawater shatters the pale wall, rushing into this seemingly boundless white space.

raw: The tide swallows all that it sees, but parts before the figure of Priestess...
content: The tide swallows all that it sees, but parts before the figure of Priestess...

raw: Like a static comet, leaving behind a black tail of calm in the sea of surging fury.
content: Like a static comet, leaving behind a black tail of calm in the sea of surging fury.

raw: [name="Theresis"]Your connection to the Originium is weakening. You are fading away.
speaker: Theresis
content: Your connection to the Originium is weakening. You are fading away.

raw: [name="Priestess"]Continuing to process this disorganized data is a waste of energy.
speaker: Priestess
content: Continuing to process this disorganized data is a waste of energy.

raw: The waves converge upon the last area, slowly submerging Priestess's figure.
content: The waves converge upon the last area, slowly submerging Priestess's figure.

raw: They also close in upon Theresis.
content: They also close in upon Theresis.

raw: [name="Priestess"]Is this the end that you sought?
speaker: Priestess
content: Is this the end that you sought?

raw: [name="Priestess"]The Sarkaz data has corrupted part of the Assimilated Universe. The data has been deleted, but I do not have time right now to repair the rewritten structures.
speaker: Priestess
content: The Sarkaz data has corrupted part of the Assimilated Universe. The data has been deleted, but I do not have time right now to repair the rewritten structures.

raw: [name="Priestess"]You can 'survive' in the Assimilated Universe in another form.
speaker: Priestess
content: You can 'survive' in the Assimilated Universe in another form.

speaker: Theresis
content: Survive?

raw: [name="Theresis"]I came to pass judgment upon the gods.
speaker: Theresis
content: I came to pass judgment upon the gods.

raw: The Sarkaz swings his sword at the creator one last time, before the torrent of information engulfs him.
content: The Sarkaz swings his sword at the creator one last time, before the torrent of information engulfs him.

raw: [CameraShake(duration=1, xstrength=15, ystrength=10, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=false, block=false)]

[name="Yvangelista XI"]And there I was, thinking that all I had to do—after I find a successor—was hand out candies to the children.
speaker: Yvangelista XI
content: And there I was, thinking that all I had to do—after I find a successor—was hand out candies to the children.

raw: [name="Yvangelista XI"]You have never proclaimed such a revelation before.
speaker: Yvangelista XI
content: You have never proclaimed such a revelation before.

speaker: 'Preserver'
content: (Unknown language) Incoming data... Originium...

raw: [name="'Preserver'"](Unknown language) A warning, or yet another swan song of hope?
speaker: 'Preserver'
content: (Unknown language) A warning, or yet another swan song of hope?

raw: [name="'Preserver'"](Unknown language) Where are you, kindred? What have you encountered?
speaker: 'Preserver'
content: (Unknown language) Where are you, kindred? What have you encountered?

raw: The wind brushes past the throne. The sovereign's gaze moves away from the depths of the void outside his domain.
content: The wind brushes past the throne. The sovereign's gaze moves away from the depths of the void outside his domain.

raw: [name="Witch King"]This music exists outside of order. How did it invade my Pavillon, my Leithanien?
speaker: Witch King
content: This music exists outside of order. How did it invade my Pavillon, my Leithanien?

speaker: Witch King
content: The traces of genesis?
Silence is broken.

raw: Priestess's figure, shattered by the golden waves of information, disappears without a trace.
content: Priestess's figure, shattered by the golden waves of information, disappears without a trace.

raw: The sea of data dashes against Theresis even more furiously.
content: The sea of data dashes against Theresis even more furiously.

raw: His mind grows crowded. His body begins to crack.
content: His mind grows crowded. His body begins to crack.

raw: The waves of information take away the blood that flows from his wounds. Originium crystals multiply in every cell...
content: The waves of information take away the blood that flows from his wounds. Originium crystals multiply in every cell...
Theresis is completely inundated.

raw: Blood-red seawater gushes from the bottomless abyss, melting into the golden sea.
content: Blood-red seawater gushes from the bottomless abyss, melting into the golden sea.

raw: The sea of data in the Assimilated Universe turns a dark red, like blood, the color of the Sarkaz.
content: The sea of data in the Assimilated Universe turns a dark red, like blood, the color of the Sarkaz.

raw: Finally, a tiny figure rises from the sea.
content: Finally, a tiny figure rises from the sea.

raw: [name="Weak Voice"]We took control of Amnannam, Theresa.
speaker: Weak Voice
content: We took control of Amnannam, Theresa.

raw: [name="Weak Voice"]I can feel the direction that the waves flow now, and the massive amounts of data that I cannot comprehend—
speaker: Weak Voice
content: I can feel the direction that the waves flow now, and the massive amounts of data that I cannot comprehend—

raw: He wants to share his joy, but there is only the sound of the waves in the boundless void.
content: He wants to share his joy, but there is only the sound of the waves in the boundless void.

raw: He can no longer hear even his own heartbeat. There is only him here.
content: He can no longer hear even his own heartbeat. There is only him here.

raw: There is no longer any meaning in staying here.
content: There is no longer any meaning in staying here.

raw: He will return alone to Terra, to the land that belongs to him—
content: He will return alone to Terra, to the land that belongs to him—

raw: The rhombus in the void grows faint and broken...
content: The rhombus in the void grows faint and broken...

raw: Priestess's consciousness once again falls into slumber.
content: Priestess's consciousness once again falls into slumber.

raw: The spread of Originium has been far slower than expected, and she has unexpectedly lost part of her control over it.
content: The spread of Originium has been far slower than expected, and she has unexpectedly lost part of her control over it.

raw: [name="Priestess"]Two Terrans, a frail and overlooked race.
speaker: Priestess
content: Two Terrans, a frail and overlooked race.

raw: [name="Priestess"]I'm starting to understand why you're so interested in them... {@nickname}.
speaker: Priestess
content: I'm starting to understand why you're so interested in them... {@nickname}.

raw: As her consciousness fades into darkness, she turns her gaze to the land known as Terra...
content: As her consciousness fades into darkness, she turns her gaze to the land known as Terra...

raw: She sees the one they call Doctor walking with the Cautus and AMa-10 into the dark passage that leads to the underground throne room—
content: She sees the one they call Doctor walking with the Cautus and AMa-10 into the dark passage that leads to the underground throne room—

raw: She sees the city of Londinium cry out in pain in the fires of war—
content: She sees the city of Londinium cry out in pain in the fires of war—
...She sees death—

raw: A disintegrating Cautus, whose information is melting into the Assimilated Universe's sea of data—
content: A disintegrating Cautus, whose information is melting into the Assimilated Universe's sea of data—
Then, she reaches out.

raw: [name="Raydistorter"](Unknown language) And that was the last time you saw Priestess?
speaker: Raydistorter
content: (Unknown language) And that was the last time you saw Priestess?

speaker: Hierda
content: (Unknown language) Yes.

raw: [name="Hierda"](Unknown language) I still have many unanswered questions. Time is no longer my major concern.
speaker: Hierda
content: (Unknown language) I still have many unanswered questions. Time is no longer my major concern.

raw: [name="Raydistorter"](Unknown language) Do you not miss your home, traveler?
speaker: Raydistorter
content: (Unknown language) Do you not miss your home, traveler?
'Miss.'

raw: —The Cautus answered this question many times when she lived on the ship that housed the gods.
content: —The Cautus answered this question many times when she lived on the ship that housed the gods.

raw: There is no future in the fragments of time reconstructed from information.
content: There is no future in the fragments of time reconstructed from information.

raw: Her best friends soon forget her existence entirely.
content: Her best friends soon forget her existence entirely.

raw: She can know all there it is to them, but she will never truly be part of life here.
content: She can know all there it is to them, but she will never truly be part of life here.

raw: 'I'm just a traveler lucky enough to catch a glimpse of the distant past.'
content: 'I'm just a traveler lucky enough to catch a glimpse of the distant past.'

raw: [name="Hierda"](Unknown language) I'm having another learning session with Presence.
speaker: Hierda
content: (Unknown language) I'm having another learning session with Presence.

raw: [name="Hierda"](Unknown language) Are you sure you don't want to come and talk to her?
speaker: Hierda
content: (Unknown language) Are you sure you don't want to come and talk to her?

raw: [name="Raydistorter"](Unknown language) You seem eager to resolve our conflict, Hierda, but I'm afraid I must decline.
speaker: Raydistorter
content: (Unknown language) You seem eager to resolve our conflict, Hierda, but I'm afraid I must decline.
They will not change.

raw: They are simply recreations of data.
content: They are simply recreations of data.

speaker: Hierda
content: (Unknown language) Very well.

raw: The Cautus looks out beyond the porthole and counts silently. When the count reaches thirty, life from the star will once again shine upon the surface of the broken planet.
content: The Cautus looks out beyond the porthole and counts silently. When the count reaches thirty, life from the star will once again shine upon the surface of the broken planet.

raw: [name="Hierda"]It's breath-taking, no matter how many times I see it...
speaker: Hierda
content: It's breath-taking, no matter how many times I see it...

raw: [name="Hierda"]Life and death emerging at the same time—
speaker: Hierda
content: Life and death emerging at the same time—

raw: A scene that she had never seen on that land. A scene that she does not wish her brethren to see.
content: A scene that she had never seen on that land. A scene that she does not wish her brethren to see.

raw: [Sticker(id="st2", multi = true, text="'Farewell. I'm leaving.'", x=250,y=350, alignment="center", duration=2, size=24, delay=0.04, width=700)]
In the blink of an eye, the Cautus finds herself back on that pale soil.
content: In the blink of an eye, the Cautus finds herself back on that pale soil.

raw: Priestess welcomes her with a smile.
content: Priestess welcomes her with a smile.

speaker: Priestess
content: Have you found your answer?
The Cautus shakes her head.

speaker: Hierda
content: Where are you going?

speaker: Priestess
content: Terra. Your home.

raw: [name="Priestess"]I want to give you a choice, Hierda.
speaker: Priestess
content: I want to give you a choice, Hierda.

raw: [name="Priestess"]You can stay, learn the knowledge that you thirst for, and find answers to the questions in your heart.
speaker: Priestess
content: You can stay, learn the knowledge that you thirst for, and find answers to the questions in your heart.

raw: [name="Priestess"]Or, I can send you back home.
speaker: Priestess
content: Or, I can send you back home.

speaker: Hierda
content: Home...? To Terra?!

raw: [name="Priestess"]However, it may mean forsaking forever the chance to find those answers.
speaker: Priestess
content: However, it may mean forsaking forever the chance to find those answers.

raw: [name="Priestess"]What's more, you will find that you have become very different from your erstwhile kin. It will bring you even more pain.
speaker: Priestess
content: What's more, you will find that you have become very different from your erstwhile kin. It will bring you even more pain.

speaker: Priestess
content: I will respect your decision, Hierda.

speaker: Hierda
content: I, I—

content: At the same time, you step into the space within the rift.

raw: Black Originium dust accumulates on the deck. Tiny Originium clusters grow like wild grass.
content: Black Originium dust accumulates on the deck. Tiny Originium clusters grow like wild grass.

raw: You can see them spreading as far as one's eyes can reach, gleaming enchantingly in the sun.
content: You can see them spreading as far as one's eyes can reach, gleaming enchantingly in the sun.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]Warn all operators still on Rhodes Island to be prepared for Catastrophe, Amiya.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Warn all operators still on Rhodes Island to be prepared for Catastrophe, Amiya.

speaker: Amiya
content: Understood.
name: Amiya

raw: [multiline(name="Amiya",end=true)]I'm not getting through! All communications have failed—
speaker: Amiya
content: I'm not getting through! All communications have failed—
name: Amiya

raw: The sight before you is inconceivable, different from any Catastrophe that you have witnessed before.
content: The sight before you is inconceivable, different from any Catastrophe that you have witnessed before.

raw: [Decision(options="The Originium expands at an impossible pace.", values="1")]
options: The Originium expands at an impossible pace.

raw: You look down at the deck, now completely covered in Originium, and see only your shadow.
content: You look down at the deck, now completely covered in Originium, and see only your shadow.

speaker: Amiya
content: Doctor—

raw: You turn around to see a stunned look on Kal'tsit's face.
content: You turn around to see a stunned look on Kal'tsit's face.

raw: You follow her gaze. Far in the distance on the deck, a small formation of black Originium is growing slowly towards the sky.
content: You follow her gaze. Far in the distance on the deck, a small formation of black Originium is growing slowly towards the sky.

raw: You see a faint white figure on every facet of the crystal.
content: You see a faint white figure on every facet of the crystal.

raw: A figure not unfamiliar to you—
content: A figure not unfamiliar to you—

raw: The black Originium rain suddenly grows more intense.
content: The black Originium rain suddenly grows more intense.

raw: It almost feels like the large black raindrops are not falling from the sky, but rushing from the ground towards the heavens.
content: It almost feels like the large black raindrops are not falling from the sky, but rushing from the ground towards the heavens.

raw: [ImageTween(yFrom=-50, yTo=0, xScaleFrom=1.2, yScaleFrom=1.2, xScaleTo=1, yScaleTo=1, duration=20, block=false)]
They refract the sunlight, drawing colorful lines in the sky—
content: They refract the sunlight, drawing colorful lines in the sky—

raw: All the colors you see begin to converge and weave into a white curtain, glistening with rainbow colors, slowly descending.
content: All the colors you see begin to converge and weave into a white curtain, glistening with rainbow colors, slowly descending.

raw: A pure, pristine white, gentle draping over the Originium crystal on the deck—
content: A pure, pristine white, gentle draping over the Originium crystal on the deck—

raw: A beautiful figure stands upon the crystal.
content: A beautiful figure stands upon the crystal.

raw: Black crystal retreats from her legs, and white light puts a layer of clothing on her.
content: Black crystal retreats from her legs, and white light puts a layer of clothing on her.

raw: Heaven and earth, white and black, and—
content: Heaven and earth, white and black, and—

raw: She looks upon the land that has long become unfamiliar to her.
content: She looks upon the land that has long become unfamiliar to her.

speaker: Priestess
content: Long time no see.
